horses.name: Thunder Hoof
horses.description: A legendary black stallion known for explosive acceleration out of the starting gates and unmatched stamina down the final stretch.

horses.name: Golden Galop
horses.description: A striking palomino favorite with a consistent, rhythmic stride that excels in medium-to-long distance sprints.

horses.name: Midnight Runner
horses.description: A dark bay gelding that loves to pace behind the pack before unleashing a ferocious late-race charge.

horses.name: Crimson Dash
horses.description: An aggressive chestnut filly with fiery speed, often setting a punishing early tempo for the rest of the field to chase.

horses.name: Emerald Wind
horses.description: A nimble grey thoroughbred that handles wet track conditions and tight turns with exceptional agility.

horses.name: Shadow Stride
horses.description: A wild card dark roan who can be unpredictable out of the gate, but possesses a terrifying top-end gear when clear.
